goal_title: Book: QFEP Laboratory: The Formula Made Interactive — improvements from the spine reading
why: The whole spine was read as a book on 2026-09-24, one sequence at a time, and every stumble, false claim or broken handover in qfeplaboratory became a task Palle can pick up one at a time. Reader: the VR visitor.
success_criteria: every open task here is done or skipped with a note
the chapters read through without a stumble in the headset
every code excerpt and number in the chapters matches the source

book.title: QFEP Laboratory: The Formula Made Interactive

reading.arc: The sequence takes the formula the crisis synthesis left lit and makes it return a number, then takes that number apart term by term. A console where four rails give one total (Introduction) is followed by a bit grid that separates a source's uncertainty from a predictor's misses (F), a fan that counts endings and closures (E), a hall where a lambda value becomes a lit route the visitor can move (Lambda), a signed rail whose old moral labels appear only on request (Phi), a reaction-diffusion pair that separates the model from the way it is stepped (Edge of Chaos), a receiver that can be connected and cut (Sandbox), and a jar body whose stiffness, damping and pressure the two weights drive (Synthesis). Every hall runs the same discipline: do the operation, name what changed, then say what was supplied rather than measured, who wrote the mapping, and what the count, colour or route cannot decide. The Q of QFEP is carried as a question of revisability, who may change the terms, rather than as a claim, and the sequence closes by turning that question on the maker (Self-Q) and handing 'whose distinctions are compressed' to the post-crisis sequence.
holds: The supplied-versus-measured refrain: every hall closes its operation with a limit stated in the same voice ('its fixed change value is not an observed rate', 'not quantities measured by this fan', 'a curatorial argument', 'visual feedback for its own value', 'Someone wrote this mapping', 'does not establish that nature uses the same numerical scale').

A chain of last-line handovers: each chapter's final sentence names the next hall's question (predictability, then counting alternatives, then invitation, then sign, then driving a pattern, then where control reaches, then what a body keeps, then compression).
Two carried controls, LAMBDA and PHI, reappear in five halls with their ranges explicitly compared, and the reader is trained on 'Read the rail as well as the letter' before trusting a symbol.

The 'you can do X; you cannot yet do Y' figure: reopen but not grow (E), move the light but not the rows (Lambda), hide the labels but carry them (Phi), connect and cut but not invent another response (Sandbox). Each apparatus's limit is stated as the next freedom.
Predict-before-reading instructions: guess before reading H, count leaves before the readout, describe persistence before naming a regime, name direction before magnitude.
Self-Q bookends: introduced in the first hall as the return of the question to the maker, closed in the last hall with 'Which part of the apparatus would we change next?'

hall_notes.note: The balance workbench: four 0-1 rails, KEEP outline, nearest-of-seven reference. Sets the sequence's method (two arrangements, one number; what the total lost) and introduces QFEP, Q and Self-Q with the two footnotes the whole sequence leans on. Densest chapter; the arithmetic paragraph arrives before the letters are named.

The Shannon workbench: p rail, bit grid, EXPECT 0/1 with amber misses. Cleanly separates source uncertainty from a predictor's fit and ends on the sharpest line of the sequence about who has to change. Reads fast and true; 'the room's F term' is its one loose phrase.

The entropy fan: CYCLE / ONE / OPEN / PRUNE, 81 leaves, 27 under 18 closures, nats versus bits. Counting is made physical, and the PRUNE / OPEN pair carries the ethical turn (reopening a route on a screen versus in a life) without preaching.

The lambda hall: an authored spectrum made walkable, then the LIT STRIP console (0.20-0.80, RETURN) lets the visitor move the recommendation and watch the rows refuse to follow. 'Light has made a recommendation, not cleared a passage' is the hall's whole argument. One slip: 'Changing the sign' in a hall with no sign.

The signed rail (particles up or down, EARLIER LABELS reveals RESIST / EMBRACE) and the transforming pattern that runs independently of PHI. Direction-then-magnitude is taught well; the lambda promenade on the way out is never mentioned, and the 'at zero' claim is only true at the start.

Two screens, same start and time, one at half the step (DT .3 / .15, HOLD / RUN, B difference). The chapter's distinction between model time, step size and SIM SPEED is exact and valuable. It trips on 'the earlier calculation' (a changelog the visitor never saw) and on a second, unwired LAMBDA rail by the door that it does not name.

Two handles, one receiver, CONNECT / CUT and REPEAT, a console that prints offered and used values. The cut-route memory ('It has not restored an innocent beginning') and 'Someone wrote this mapping' land. The neighbouring particle field is correctly described as not joined (its listener group is never populated).

The morphology specimen: its own LAMBDA and PHI, PAIR A/B/C, PULSE / STEADY, a plate of stiffness, damping, drag and pressure. Separates imposed breathing from the body's own motion and closes the sequence with Self-Q and a clean hand to post-crisis. The floor's EGG / IMAGO / RETURN TRANSFORMED inscriptions contradict its refusal to read the jar as an assay of life.

stumbles: QFEP_Edge_Of_Chaos: 'move LAMBDA slowly. Give the image time to respond' - the LAMBDA rail three cells from the spawn is a separate slider whose #locked:0.4 token does nothing (it moves freely and drives nothing in the hall); the console the chapter means is on the east side and is never located.
QFEP_Lambda_Spectrum: the chalkboard beside the entrance reads 'life at λ ≈ 0.4' while the chapter says the chosen value 'is not a universal threshold at which life, creativity or queerness appears'.
QFEP_Synthesis: the floor says EGG, THE PLINTH OF BECOMING, IMAGO, RETURN TRANSFORMED while the chapter says 'A responsive specimen is not an assay of queerness or a test for life'.
QFEP_Lambda_Spectrum: 'Changing the sign does not erase the arrangement' - there is no sign to change in this hall; sign is the next hall's word.

QFEP_Edge_Of_Chaos: 'The earlier calculation could produce a pattern largely through overshooting and clipping its values' - the visitor never saw an earlier calculation; the paragraph reads as a changelog.
QFEP_Phi_Term: a 4.34 m rail of eight bodies with lambda numerals stands between the transforming pattern and the exit, unmentioned in the hall that was introduced with 'Phi introduces time'.
QFEP_Phi_Term: 'At zero, no new particles are released' - true only for the configured start; a hand cannot return the continuous rail to exact zero, so after the first move the emitter never stops.
QFEP_F_Term: 'The room's F term asks a related but different question' - the room contains no F device; the visitor looks for one.
QFEP_Introduction: the previous chapter promised 'We will meet it again in the laboratory', and the lit formula does hang at the back of this hall, but the chapter never turns to it.

QFEP_Synthesis: 'Breathing varies around that pressure baseline within an interval the maker selected' - the reader is not told that breathing only runs while lambda sits between 0.3 and 0.7, so the plate's STEADY outside that band looks like a failed button.
QFEP_Edge_Of_Chaos: 'Keep a record in words' - a headset visitor has nothing to write on.

keep.quote: One number can summarise several contributions while concealing how they compensated for one another. Keeping the separate values visible prevents a convenient summary from becoming the whole account.
A familiar symbol does not guarantee the same range. Read the rail as well as the letter.
Here you can change the expectation with one button. Elsewhere a system might insist that the world change instead. Keep that difference with you.
Outside this little machine, reopening a route may not restore the lives or histories lost when it closed. The ease of the button is part of the experiment's limit.
Stay with the difference between more endings on a screen and more ways to live.
Light has made a recommendation, not cleared a passage.
Disconnection has left a memory of your action. It has not restored an innocent beginning.
Steady pressure is something you have given it. Stillness would be something else.

reading.handover_in: Clean in voice and in claim. Crisis_Synthesis ends 'Leave the formula lit. We will meet it again in the laboratory, where particular implementations give its terms consequences' and 'An equals sign waits'; QFEP_Introduction opens 'In the previous room, the formula waited to be questioned. Here it returns a number.' Both keep the formula a research proposal rather than a law, and the crisis chapter's caution about ΔE needing a duration is honoured by the console's 'fixed change value is not an observed rate'. The one loose thread is physical: the formula the visitor was told to leave lit hangs again at the back of the introduction hall (qfep_formula_3d at map_data.json:592, floor label THE FORMULA at :346) and the chapter never acknowledges the reunion it promised.
reading.handover_out: Clean. QFEP_Synthesis ends 'Post-crisis begins with representation itself. After learning to name a model's choices, ask whose distinctions those choices make clear and whose they compress', and CriticalAlgorithms_Algorithmic_Bias_Visualization opens on exactly that: 'Which differences become difficult to recognise when a representation gives some words less room?' with a COMPRESSION handle. The Self-Q closing paragraph and the next hall's 'Both groups were chosen' share one question. Nothing to fix here.

tasks.title: 'At zero, no new particles are released' holds only at the configured start
tasks.spec:
[code-claim] QFEP_Phi_Term
Quote: “At zero, no new particles are released; those already in flight take a moment to disappear.”
Why: The emitter stops only when is_zero_approx(phi) is true; phi is (position / rail_length) * 2 - 1 from a continuous hand-moved rail, so after the first grab the visitor cannot return to exact zero and sees particles still leaving, only slower (speed = |phi| * 0.20 m/s). The sentence then reads as false.
Do: Rewrite: 'The handle starts at zero, and nothing is released. Once you have moved it, bringing it back near zero only slows the release to a crawl; watch the speed rather than waiting for silence.' (Or, code: a dead band such as absf(phi) < 0.02 at phi_slider.gd:658, in which case the sentence can stay.)
